# Magnolia of Staffing (`magnolia-of-staffing`)

Nursing-home staffing and PBJ checks: hours per resident day by role against your targets, days without 8 consecutive RN hours, agency invoices against agency timecards and the Payroll-Based Journal due date. Employee names and ids are masked before results reach the model.

**Magnolia never submits PBJ files to CMS.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Payroll and staffing · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y magnolia-of-staffing demo
npx -y magnolia-of-staffing mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

One fictional Cedar Hollow week, 23 to 29 March 2026, with 40 residents, checked on 20 April. The example targets are 3.48 total, 0.55 RN and 2.45 aide hours per resident day. Planted:

- Weekdays meet every target.
- Saturday 28 March has RN shifts of 7 to 11, 12 to 16 and 17 to 23, so there is never 8 unbroken RN hours. That day is short on every target.
- Sunday is short on aide hours.
- The agency billed 12 hours on 25 March for a shift our time records show as 8.
- PBJ for the quarter ending 31 March is due 15 May and is not marked submitted.

Shifts that cross midnight count on the day they start. Employee names and ids are in [`phi-canaries.json`](fixtures/phi-canaries.json); they must never reach the model. [`rules-typo.json`](fixtures/rules-typo.json) misspells a setting, so the check refuses it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `magnolia_check` | Work out nursing hours per resident day, RN coverage, agency hours and the PBJ deadline for a date range. | runs |
| `magnolia_write_report` | Write magnolia-staffing.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and magnolia-staffing.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/magnolia). | runs |
| `magnolia_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `magnolia_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `magnolia_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `magnolia_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `pbj_submit` | Magnolia never submits PBJ files to CMS. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `magnolia_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `time` (required) | Nursing time records under --root: employee, role (RN, LPN, CNA...), date, in, out or hours, agency |
| `census` (required) | Census under --root for the same dates |
| `invoices` | Optional agency invoices under --root: agency, employee, date, hours billed |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: targets, pbj_submitted, pbj_warn_days |
| `start` (required) | First day to check (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end` (required) | Last day to check (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `as_of` | Date for the PBJ deadline (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx magnolia-of-staffing inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Nursing time records (`time`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, Badge |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name, Staff |
| `role` (required) | text | Role, Job Title, Position, Job Code, Discipline |
| `date` (required) | date | Date, Work Date, Shift Date |
| `in` | text | In, Time In, Clock In, Start |
| `out` | text | Out, Time Out, Clock Out, End |
| `hours` | number | Hours, Hours Worked, Total Hours |
| `agency` | text | Agency Staff, Is Agency, Contract |
| `agency_name` | text | Agency, Agency Name, Staffing Agency, Vendor |

### Census (`census`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `resident_id` | text (masked) | Resident ID, Resident #, Resident Number, Res ID, Res #, MRN, Medical Record Number, Client ID |
| `resident_name` | text (masked) | Resident, Resident Name, Name, Patient, Patient Name, Client Name, Resident Full Name |
| `facility` | text | Facility, Facility Name, Building, Location, Fac, Center |
| `from` (required) | date | From, Start, Start Date, Effective Date, Begin Date, From Date, Admit Date, Census Date |
| `to` | date | To, End, End Date, Thru, Through, Thru Date, Through Date, To Date |
| `payer` (required) | text | Payer, Payer Name, Primary Payer, Pay Source, Payer Source, Payor, Payor Name, Insurance |
| `payer_type` | text | Payer Type, Payor Type, Payer Class, Payer Category, Pay Type |
| `level` | text | Level, Level of Care, Care Level, Rate Type, Rate Level, Room Type, Accommodation, RUG |
| `bed_status` | text | Bed Status, Status, Census Status, Action, Census Action, Leave Type |
| `room` | text | Room, Room Bed, Bed, Room/Bed, Unit |

### Agency invoices (`invoices`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `agency` (required) | text | Agency, Agency Name, Staffing Agency, Vendor |
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, Badge |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name, Staff |
| `date` (required) | date | Date, Shift Date, Work Date |
| `hours` (required) | number | Hours, Billed Hours, Hours Billed |

## Settings file (`magnolia_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `targets` | Your hours-per-resident-day targets (your state minimum or your own goal) |
| `pbj_submitted` | PBJ submission dates by quarter end: {"2026-03-31": "2026-05-02"} |
| `pbj_warn_days` | Warn this many days before the PBJ deadline (default 30) |

## Memory

`magnolia_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `magnolia_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `staffing_note` | is shown with results. It never changes a check. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "magnolia-of-staffing": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "magnolia-of-staffing",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add magnolia-of-staffing -- npx -y magnolia-of-staffing mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
magnolia-of-staffing tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
magnolia-of-staffing sources               # the columns each input is read from
magnolia-of-staffing inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
magnolia-of-staffing call magnolia_check '{"time":"<time>","census":"<census>","start":"<start>","end":"<end>"}'
magnolia-of-staffing eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
magnolia-of-staffing demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
